name: Montage Big Sky
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out Montana mountain resort in the Spanish Peaks enclave, 45 minutes from Yellowstone National Park
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access and help with rentals, lessons and lift tickets
Families looking for winter activities like ice skating and tubing steps from the door
Travelers combining a mountain stay with Yellowstone National Park

facts.text: Guestrooms, suites and residences are set across three settings: The Lodge, the Inn and the Mountain Homes.
The resort's design palette uses locally sourced woods and stones.
The resort was developed in partnership with Lone Mountain Land Company and is Montage's second mountain property, after Deer Valley.
Spa Montage offers signature Elements of Wellness treatments and an indoor pool.
The spa offers facials with Valmont and Arcona products, sound healing, and massages that help guests acclimate to the altitude.
The resort has five dining outlets, including wood-fired Italian cuisine and fresh-caught fish.
Wildflower Market serves coffee, breakfast burritos and house-made pastries, plus grab-and-go sandwiches and salads.
Beartooth Pub and Rec has arcade games and an adjacent bowling alley.
In winter, an ice skating rink, a tubing hill and a designated beginner ski area are steps from the hotel door.
The on-site activity center, Compass Sports, sells lift tickets and arranges ski lockers, rentals, boot fittings, lessons and guides in winter.
In summer, golfers can play the private 18-hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf.
A complimentary Cadillac program helps guests get around.

highlights.text: Montage Big Sky offers ski-in/ski-out access.
Montage Big Sky is located 45 minutes from Yellowstone National Park.
The hotel's art collection is all from Montana artists.
It is the first Montage property that is 100% plastic-free.
Cortina serves Northern Italian dishes such as braised ossobuco and paccheri Bolognese topped with white truffle.

considerations.text: The resort sits within the Spanish Peaks enclave, about a 20-minute drive from the Big Sky Resort base area and main town.
The nearest lift, Lewis & Clark, accesses beginner-friendly terrain.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires travel planning.
